_comment: Event-STDP control for B-EMA (2026-10-17): the STDP pairs are taken between block-to-block changes of k^ and v (window (1 - lam) lam^|a-b| sin(omegaT (a-b)), no latency: tag_bound 0), accumulated as W <- (1 - eta) W + eta P with eta 0.125 as in B-EMA, and read by the query's change; the Hebbian read stays on the states. Linear events (event_theta 0), odd window only (event_even false). 8 blocks per segment.
